description: Defines classes and templates for handling asynchronous completion callbacks, primarily used for testing asynchronous operations in the Chromium project. Includes internal classes, callback wrappers, and utility classes for managing callback results and synchronization.

classes.name: TestCompletionCallbackBase
classes.description: Base class for testing completion callbacks with integer result types.

classes.name: TestInt64CompletionCallbackBase
classes.description: Base class for testing completion callbacks with int64_t result types.

classes.name: TestCompletionCallback
classes.description: Concrete class for testing completion callbacks returning int.

classes.name: TestInt64CompletionCallback
classes.description: Concrete class for testing completion callbacks returning int64_t.

classes.name: ReleaseBufferCompletionCallback
classes.description: Ensures the IOBuffer is not referenced when the callback runs, used for testing buffer release.

methods.name: callback
methods.description: Returns a callback that sets the result of the test callback.

methods.name: SetResult
methods.description: Overrides to set the callback result and signal completion.

methods.name: WaitForResult
methods.description: Waits for the asynchronous operation to complete and returns the result.
